Get Started

Welcome

Get Started on your Journey to Master AI Prompting

​
Our Mission

To democratize access to the most important skill of the 21st century: AI Prompting. Prompt University is a free, education community designed to bridge the gap between passive AI consumption and active AI orchestration. New: We’ve expanded beyond education to become the world’s first open-source AI research lab. Our three-layer research system (Undergrad, Graduate, Applied) tracks every AI model, research paper, and frontier capability—completely transparent and community-driven.

​
Join for Free

Prompt University aims to become the premier global hub for the Intelligence Economy, creating a generation of workers who are not threatened by AI, but empowered to build on top of it. We are not just teaching people how to use a chatbot; we are training the Architects of the future.

​
What Makes Us Different

🎓 Free Education

Comprehensive curriculum from basics to advanced prompting techniques. No paywalls, no upsells—just knowledge.

🔬 Open Research

Our model database, frontier rankings, and research analysis are completely open source. Community-driven validation ensures accuracy.

⚡ Real-Time Tracking

We discover new models from X, Instagram, LinkedIn, and arXiv daily. Our frontier index updates as the landscape evolves.

🤝 Community First

Join 10,000+ Architects in our Discord. Share discoveries, get feedback, and collaborate on projects.

​
Latest Research Updates

​
Open Research Launch
  • Launched open-source model database with 150+ tracked models
  • New Frontier Index ranking best models by capability
  • Research paper cross-referencing now live
  • Community contributions welcome!

​
Three Pillars

​
1. Education (Prompting 101)

Master the craft of AI communication through our three-module curriculum:
  • Module 1: Foundations and basic techniques
  • Module 2: Advanced prompting patterns
  • Module 3: Building AI-powered workflows

​
2. Research (Open Database)

Track the rapidly evolving AI landscape:
  • Model Database: Social discovery + validation
  • Research Papers: Impact analysis on deployed models
  • Frontier Index: Capability-to-model mappings

​
3. Application (Applied Tasks)

Real-world problem-solving workflows:
  • Studio Tasks: Production-ready workflows
  • Model Selection: Which AI for which job
  • Cost Optimization: Best results per dollar

​
For Companies

Prompt University isn’t just for individuals. We help organizations:
  • Train teams on effective AI usage
  • Track frontier models for strategic planning
  • Document workflows for knowledge sharing
  • Validate claims before vendor selection
Contact us for enterprise training and research partnerships.
